# Henry W. Coe State Park

> A comprehensive guide to California's largest state park featuring hiking, camping, backpacking, mountain biking, and horseback riding in the Diablo Range.

Henry W. Coe State Park is a vast 87,000-acre wilderness area in the San Francisco Bay Area managed by the state with support from the Pine Ridge Association nonprofit. The site provides visitor planning resources, trail information, real-time conditions, and details on multiple park entrances including Coe Ranch, Hunting Hollow, and Dowdy Ranch.

## Key Topics

- Henry W. Coe State Park
- Hiking trails
- Camping

## Getting Started

- [Henry W. Coe State Park Homepage](https://coepark.net): Main entry point with visitor guide and overview of outdoor recreation opportunities
- [Plan Your Visit](https://coepark.net/planning-your-visit): Comprehensive visitor planning guide covering entrances, trails, camping, and park resources
- [About Coe Park](https://coepark.net/about-coe-park): Overview of Henry W. Coe State Park geography, features, and visitor information

## Visitor Information & Planning

- [Visitor Centers and Park Entrances](https://coepark.net/planning-your-visit/visitor-centers-and-park-entrances): Details on Coe Ranch, Hunting Hollow, and other park entrances and facilities
- [Park Hours](https://coepark.net/planning-your-visit/hoursofoperation): Operating hours for park headquarters, Hunting Hollow, and Dowdy Ranch Visitor Center
- [Trail Conditions](https://coepark.net/planning-your-visit/trail-conditions): Current trail status and conditions for hiking, biking, and backcountry camping
- [Weather at Coe Park](https://coepark.net/planning-your-visit/weather-at-coe-park): Real-time weather forecasts and conditions for Coe Park planning
- [Water Resources](https://coepark.net/planning-your-visit/water-resources): Guide to water availability at springs, creeks, and ponds throughout Coe Park
- [Park Map](https://coepark.net/parkmaps2): 2023 park map with trails, camping areas, and digital ordering information
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://coepark.net/planning-your-visit/faq): FAQ covering park hours, directions, safety tips, and visitor information

## Outdoor Activities

- [Hiking in Coe Park](https://coepark.net/hiking): Hiking trail guide and day-hike recommendations for Coe Park
- [Camping](https://coepark.net/camping): Camping guide covering Coe Ranch Campground, reservations, and amenities
- [Backpacking in Coe Park](https://coepark.net/backpacking): Backpacking guide with campsite registration and multi-day trip information
- [Mountain Biking in Coe Park](https://coepark.net/biking): Mountain biking trail guide with difficulty levels and e-bike rules
- [Horseback Riding](https://coepark.net/riding): Equestrian trail guide with day rides and horse camping information

## Park Events & Community

- [Park Events](https://coepark.net/park-events): Calendar of hiking, camping, and outdoor events at Henry W. Coe State Park
- [The Pine Ridge Association](https://coepark.net/pra): Pine Ridge Association nonprofit organization supporting Henry W. Coe State Park

## Park Resources

- [History of Coe Park](https://coepark.net/about-coe-park/history): Historical overview of Diablo Range park including Native American and gold rush era
- [Photo Albums](https://coepark.net/about-coe-park/coe-park-photo-albums): Photo gallery and archives of wildlife and nature photography from Coe Park
- [Dogs at Coe Park](https://coepark.net/planning-your-visit/dogs): Pet policy and dog-friendly trails at Coe Park campgrounds and entrances
